findings.title: Preserve returned OwnedJob evidence before fallible output hashing
findings.trigger: OwnedJob has returned; observed_ref(stdout) or observed_ref(stderr) raises OSError
findings.impact: All invocation.update keyword arguments are evaluated before mutation; known actual_exit and complete job cleanup remain NULL and are lost from returned state
findings.fix: Store observation/actual_exit/ended_at before any artifact read/hash/write, then retain artifact errors without replacing known job evidence or retrying
